response: The extent of lymphadenectomy should not be modified by neoadjuvant chemotherapy in cervical cancer. According to the available data, the frequency and topographic distribution of lymph node metastases (LNM) are not modified by neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT), and clinical non-responders showed more involved lymph nodes. Therefore, a systemic and extensive lymphadenectomy should be performed in patients treated with NACT plus surgery, regardless of the response to NACT. This approach ensures comprehensive removal of potentially affected lymph nodes, which is crucial for effective treatment and management of cervical cancer.
